Runbook links present.
8. 9. Content rule: independent dash grep over all E6 files; dashScan still green.

- npm run typecheck && npm run build
- uv run pytest -q (expect 170 = 160 E1-E6 baseline + 10 concurrent atlas tests; confirm which are which) and uv run python -m scripts.engine.verify (PASS sha256 9ec428bf... unchanged)
- git status + scoped git diffs to confirm the E6 change set matches the scope list

- Q1: [your question]

456:  * rng is injectable so the smoke test can pin the answer.
457:  */
458: export function pickRandomAccount(
459:   artifact: ProfilesArtifact | null | undefined,
460:   options: PickRandomOptions = {},
461: ): string | null {
462:   const excludeId = options.excludeId ?? null
463:   const rng = options.rng ?? Math.random
464:   const pool = randomAccountPool(artifact).filter((id) => id !== excludeId)
465:   if (pool.length === 0) {
466:     return null
467:   }
468:   const sample = rng()
469:   const index = Number.isFinite(sample) ? Math.floor(sample * pool.length) : 0
470:   const clamped = Math.min(pool.length - 1, Math.max(0, index))
471:   return pool[clamped] ?? null
472: }

351:  * 8. zero_household_bills: household bills H exactly 0.
352:  *

354:  * the bar before the first lookup. Flags never change a metric and

372:   const context: GuardContext = {

374:     loanStatus: null,
375:   }

377:   if (!idKnown) {

379:   }

381:   const profile = input.profile ?? null
382:   if (profile) {
383:     context.loanStatus = profile.loan === null ? null : profile.loan.status
384:     if (profile.flags.pensioner) flags.push(fire('pensioner', context))
385:     if (profile.flags.zero_income) flags.push(fire('zero_income', context))
386:     if (profile.flags.thin_history) flags.push(fire('thin_history', context))
387:     if (profile.flags.negative_buffer) flags.push(fire('negative_buffer', context))
388:     if (profile.flags.defaulted_loan) flags.push(fire('defaulted_loan', context))
389:     if (isCount(profile.loan_payment_cents) && profile.loan_payment_cents === 0) {
390:       flags.push(fire('no_loan', context))
391:     }
392:     if (isCount(profile.household_bills_cents) && profile.household_bills_cents === 0) {
393:       flags.push(fire('zero_household_bills', context))

The golden fixture baseline matches the sheet: I 650326, S 716084, B 643785, H 430672, P 284493, gap 65758, deci 98 -> 9.8. 

The layoff numbers (income_after 357679, gap_after 358405, deci 18) are not in the golden fixtures expected block. The contract says "worked example figures match golden_fixtures.json 68257 (I 650326, S 716084, B 643785, H 430672, P 284493, gap 65758, baseline 98 -> 9.8; layoff income_after 357679, gap_after 358405, deci 18 -> 1.8)". The layoff figures presumably come from shocks.py math (0.55 x I). Check: 650326 * 0.55 = 357679.3. In integer cents math, how is 0.55 applied? Probably (11*I)//20 = (11*650326)//20 = 7153586//20 = 357679.3 -> floor 357679. ✓ gap after = 716084 - 357679 = 358405. ✓ deci = (20*643785 + 358405)//(2*358405) = (12875700+358405)//716810 = 13234105//716810 = 18.46 -> 18. ✓ deci 18 -> 1.8 months. All arithmetic checks out and consistent with the shock formula "income after = 0.55 x I (EI)".
